text.p: The shareholders of Grove Bank voted Thursday at their special shareholder meeting to approve the Nov 4 merger agreement of Citizens Financial Group, Citizens Bank of Massachusetts, and Grove Bank.
Under the terms, Grove shareholders will get $51 for each of their shares. The acquisition is subject to various regulatory approvals, the company said.

Grove Bank is a Massachusetts-chartered community bank founded in 1914. On Jan. 2, 1997 Grove completed the acquisition of Greater Boston Bank. The combined bank has approximately $630 million of deposits and $755 million in total assets. Grove's deposits are insured by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. (FDIC) and the Depositors Insurance Fund (DIF).
